# Template contribution form moved

This legacy form is no longer used. Submit new content or a correction through
the [current browser-based contribution form](https://github.com/mirichard/pm-tools-templates/issues/new?template=content_submission.yml).
You do not need Git or to convert your file. Read the
[submission handling guide](../../docs/community/submission-handling.md) before
uploading sanitized files.
